full_name: Jessica Bardsley | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2018–2019 Arleen Carlson and Edna Nelson Graduate Fellow Harvard University
bio: Jessica Bardsley is an artist and PhD candidate in visual and environmental studies and critical media practice at Harvard University, where she is also a Film Study Center–Harvard Fellow.
